source: Dewberry PER 2021: Executive Summary hydraulic analysis (p.7-8), Sections 3.1.2-3.3.8 results (p.30-47), Project summary (p.48). Withheld or stripped.
question: Capacity, steady pressures and surge of the EGPS force main with 42-inch DR-21 HDPE replacing 2.5 miles of 48-inch FRP, now and with 3-5 duty pumps.

items.engineers: Existing 2 duty pumps still meet 14.1 MGD with the 42-inch HDPE: 13,808 gpm (20.0 MGD) at 172 ft to Richmond; 12,738 gpm (18.4 MGD) at 183 ft to Henrico; 12,414 gpm (17.9 MGD) at 186 ft to Henrico with Gambles Mill active (worst case).
leak_phrases: 17.9 MGD at the highest head operating condition
firm capacity of EGPS when pumping to Richmond is 13,808 gpm

items.engineers: With 5 duty pumps: 22,144 gpm (31.9 MGD) at 213 ft to Richmond, 19,944 gpm (28.7 MGD) Henrico, 19,319 gpm (27.8 MGD) at 225 ft Henrico with Gambles Mill, meeting the 27.1 MGD 2045 requirement.
leak_phrases: with a flow of 27.8 MGD with 5 duty pumps operating
it can provide 27.8 MGD of flow at the highest head condition

items.engineers: Steady pressures 0-72/77/79 psi with 2 pumps and up to 82/88/89 psi with 5 pumps; HDPE velocity ~3.8-4.2 ft/s (2 pumps) and ~6.2-7.1 ft/s (5 pumps), FRP 2.2-4.2 ft/s, all within 2-10 ft/s.
leak_phrases: Pressures in the force main range from 0 psi to 89 psi
Pressures in the force main range from 0 psi to 79 psi

items.engineers: Current pump-trip transients stay within limits: HDPE max 88-91 psi, min about -2 psi; FRP max 93-98 psi (98 psi at Phase 1 Sta. 131+60 when pumping to Henrico, just under its 100 psi limit), min -2 to -3 psi.
leak_phrases: maximum pressure of 98 psi occurs at station 131+60

items.engineers: With 5 pumps to Henrico the remaining FRP exceeds its 100 psi allowable surge (102-103 psi around Phase 2 Sta. 142+00-153+31 / 149+00, 101 psi at 73+75); 3 duty pumps already give 102 psi at 149+00 and 4 pumps reach 100 psi at 131+60. HDPE stays at 90-97 psi, well under its 200 psig surge allowance; Richmond outfall stays within limits.
leak_phrases: rise above the acceptable limit of 100 psi for the FRP pipe
transient pressure rises to 102 psi at one point

items.engineers: Keep all combination air/vacuum valves in service (reuse or replace in kind on HDPE); before adding the 3rd (and 4th/5th) duty pump do a detailed transient study to add surge mitigation on the FRP or replace more FRP with HDPE; lowering the station surge relief valve set points from 110/120 to 100 psi helps but is not enough alone.
leak_phrases: When EGPS is upgraded to include 3 duty pumps, perform a detailed transient evaluation
lowered setpoint allows the valve to open
